name: Northern Solar Holdings Berhad
overview: Northern Solar Holdings Berhad 今年获得多项太阳能相关合约，包括为数据中心项目提供89MWac太阳能及电池储能系统的企业可再生能源供应合约，并与中国电力工程顾问集团西北电力设计院签署谅解备忘录，合作竞标大型太阳能项目的EPCC主承包商角色。公司同时进行集资活动。
overview_en: Northern Solar Holdings Berhad secured several solar-related contracts this year, including a corporate renewable energy supply contract for an 89MWac solar plus battery energy storage system for a data centre project, and signed a memorandum of understanding with Northwest Electric Power Design Institute Co., Ltd. of China Power Engineering Consulting Group to collaborate in bidding for the main contractor role for EPCC services for Large Scale Solar projects.

segments.name: 太阳能光伏EPC与调试
segments.note: 今年获得数据中心项目太阳能供应合约，并与中国设计院合作竞标大型太阳能项目EPCC主承包商。
segments.note_en: Secured a solar supply contract for a data centre project this year and collaborated with a Chinese design institute to bid for the main EPCC contractor role for Large Scale Solar projects.
